newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady despite thin enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady despite thin enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were steady on Wednesday in spite of thin enquiries but remained firm compared to other regional bunker centres, traders said.
"Bunker prices probably need a sharp drop before demand returns," said a trader at a major oil company. "That will only happen when the cargo price comes off."

Traders said Singapore bunker prices were quite high compared to other regional sellers. Offers were broadly steady from Tuesday with 180-cst indicated at $112-$113, 380 cst at $107-$108, gas oil at $203-$205 and MDO at $190-$193.
